findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "analyze_contract_with_cohere" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read a whole tender package with Cohere Command A+ and explain it to a business owner: what it is, who can bid, how offers are evaluated, everything that must b…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_server_guide, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, get_buyer_award_history, submit_feedback · Private data: process_bid_room, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, submit_feedback · Public sink: process_bid_room, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, submit_feedback · Destructive: classify_tender, unwatch_opportunity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_server_guide, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, get_buyer_award_history, submit_feedback · Private data: process_bid_room, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, submit_feedback · Public sink: process_bid_room, classify_tender, analyze_contract_with_cohere, submit_feedback · Destructive: classify_tender, unwatch_opportunity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
